name: Pork Chops with Raspberry-Coconut Salsa, Snap Peas & Garlic Rice

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
2 (6 oz) pkgs raspberries
1 small pkg fresh mint
2 (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water. Set aside to drain.
Peel and mince garlic; trim and cut green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, green onion, rice, and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add broth to the saucepan and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 pork chops, boneless
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer chops to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
While the chops are cooking, roughly chop raspberries and place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl with the raspberries.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with coconut, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper; gently stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup shredded unsweetened coconut
4 tsp apple cider vinegar
2 tsp honey
½ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium heat. Add snap peas, water, salt, and pepper; stir to combine, cover, bring to a simmer, and cook until just fork-tender, about 3 minutes. Uncover and continue to cook until liquid has evaporated, 1 minute more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup water
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice, chops, snap peas, and raspberry-coconut salsa between plates. Enjoy!
